summary: Awin data says TopCashback shoppers spend more and convert better, backing the push to credit cashback beyond the last click.

Impact, CJ, Rakuten and the retailers had nothing new.

items.title: Awin data backs TopCashback's push to move cashback beyond the last click
items.why: Another sign the affiliate industry is moving away from 'last click takes all', which changes how every link in a buyer's journey gets credited.
